description: Resolve component/GPU assets and workload privilege contracts, compare caller authority separately from component-effective host/device/RBAC privileges, analyze integration deltas, and triage A1-A9 candidates.

history.notes: Add Stage B effective runtime privilege bindings and Stage C caller/runtime privilege deltas with semantic host/device/RBAC comparison and ownership rules
Add A9 accelerator device/node isolation, GPU assets, mandatory device/memory/partition/IPC/fabric/agent/driver coverage, and GPU-aware Stage B-D contracts
Make tenant GPU workload execution a default attacker origin and require cross-tenant, node-local, direct-cluster, control-plane, and non-network path coverage
Consume Stage A baselines and separate platform binding, reachability, identity/policy, integration delta, verification, and CVE triage
